mcat_description.short: Bunk House Office is a prefabricated, portable steel cabin used as a temporary site office or combined office-cum-accommodation unit on construction sites, industrial projects, and remote worksites. Sold per unit or per square foot, in standard or custom dimensions, with built-in electrical fittings, doors, windows, and optional amenities.
mcat_description.long: A Bunk House Office is a factory-manufactured, modular steel structure designed for rapid deployment as a temporary workspace, site office, or worker accommodation cabin at construction sites, infrastructure projects, and industrial facilities. The structure typically comprises a mild steel or GI frame with sandwich panel or PUF-insulated walls, a colour-coated steel roof, vinyl or FRP flooring, and aluminium-framed sliding windows with provision for AC, electrical wiring, and locking doors. Standard commercial sizes range from 10×10 ft to 40×10 ft, with custom dimensions available; units can be stacked as double-decker configurations for multi-storey site office complexes. Buyers procure these as ready-to-use, transportable units that can be relocated by crane or truck to new project sites, making them a cost-effective alternative to permanent construction for temporary operational needs.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Bunk House Office' is a well-established product category referring to factory-manufactured, portable steel cabins deployed as temporary site offices or combined office-accommodation units at construction, infrastructure, and industrial project sites. The dominant commercial form is a mild steel (MS) or GI-framed cabin with PUF or EPS sandwich panel walls, colour-coated steel roofing, and vinyl or FRP flooring, available in standard sizes (10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 40×10 ft) or custom dimensions. Key manufacturing hubs include Maharashtra (Thane, Navi Mumbai, Mumbai), Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Gandhinagar), Uttar Pradesh (Noida, Greater Noida), and Karnataka (Bengaluru), with pan-India supply and delivery. The product is also traded as 'Porta Cabin,' 'Site Container Office,' 'Portable Office Cabin,' and 'MS Bunk House' — these are functionally equivalent terms in the Indian market. Container-type bunk house offices (ISO container-based) represent a premium sub-segment favoured for remote or extreme-climate deployments. Double-decker configurations serve multi-storey site office requirements. No specific BIS/IS standard governs this product category as a whole; structural steel components follow IS 2062 (mild steel) norms, and insulation panels may reference IS standards for thermal performance.
